manifest.name: dsh-model-picker
manifest.description: Searchable, curated composer model picker with a Plugins page to show, hide, and pin models, plus live provider refresh and model discovery.

bundle.text:
# dsh-model-picker bundle patch.
#
# MIT License — Copyright (c) 2026 Yannick Baettig. SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT.
# Full license text in LICENSE.
#
# Inserts the model picker curation plugin row into the web profile roster.
# Applied as a profile bundle layer (the `dsh.bundle.patch` manifest field);
# install with:
#   dsh plugin --profile web add link:<repo>
#
# One package, both halves: the node half (exports ".") exists only so this row
# mounts in the host Loader — it registers nothing; the browser half (declared
# by `dsh.client`, served from lib/client.js) replaces the composer model
# picker seat with a searchable version and adds the "Model Picker" settings
# page. Remove the row (or `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-model-picker`)
# to restore the shipped picker.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-model-picker
      name: 'dsh-model-picker'

readme.text: Searchable DSH Web composer model picker with a **Plugins → Model Picker** page to hide, pin and reorder models, set a persistent default reasoning effort per model, and refresh provider catalogs. Per-model effort defaults are applied whenever you select that model in a session. This plugin does not set the default model for newly created sessions; configure that separately in DSH's `agent-default-model` plugin settings.
DSH 0.1.7 or newer, including 0.2.x, the `web` profile, and Node.js `^22.19.0` or `>=24.0.0` for source development.

Install the tagged GitHub release into your DSH Web profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add 'https://github.com/yoggu/dsh-model-picker.git#v0.1.1'
```

Or download the source and link the local checkout. Install its dependencies first; a linked package resolves them from its own directory:

```sh
git clone --branch v0.1.1 --depth 1 https://github.com/yoggu/dsh-model-picker.git
cd dsh-model-picker
pnpm install
dsh plugin --profile web add "link:$(pwd)"

Keep a linked checkout in place while the plugin is installed. Use the profile you actually run if it is not `web`.

Restart DSH Web if necessary and reload the page. Open **Plugins → Model Picker** to curate the available models. Configure model providers and credentials in DSH separately; this plugin does not supply them.

To uninstall: `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-model-picker`.

**Refresh providers** reloads DSH's catalog and can query the configured `baseURL` of active providers for model IDs. It can append discovered models to those providers' settings; review provider endpoints before invoking it. It does not create providers, credentials or inference routes. Models only appear in the composer when the running DSH session catalog serves them. Refresh can warn that a provider requires a DSH restart.

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm test
```

Tests use mocked services and do not query live providers.
